Subject: Request: SOC 2 / DPA compressed walkthrough — initial availability

Hi Karthik / Marissa,

We're kicking off a combined SOC 2 evidence review and DPA scope confirmation ahead of an upcoming pen test. Our pen test vendor has recommended a 90–120 minute window, but given calendar limitations on our side we're hoping to see if Redwood can support a compressed 60–75 minute walk-through that still covers controls mapping, data flow boundaries, and key logs/audit locations.

Attendees on our side: myself (security lead), Ben Howard (infra), and our pen-test vendor (TBD) — we'll share the vendor contact once confirmed.

Can you share narrow availability next week (Apr 26–30) for a 60–75 minute block, and confirm who from Redwood would need to be present (eng/product/security)? If a full hour isn't workable, please propose three short windows and we'll pick the best fit.

I've attached a one-page draft scope to help orient the session (draft-scope.pdf).

Thanks,
Ellen Park

Hi Ellen — thanks for the note and the scope doc.

We can do a compressed session but want to set expectations up front so the time is effective: to cover controls mapping + DPA boundaries + evidence locations in ~75 minutes we'll need a focused agenda and one technical lead (serving runtime) plus one product/security interviewer. Marissa will join as our compliance SME; Camila will bring the operations context.

Proposed 75-minute slots (all PT):
- Wed, Apr 28 — 15:00–16:15
- Thu, Apr 29 — 10:30–11:45
- Fri, Apr 30 — 08:30–09:45

Proposed agenda (45 min focused walk-through, 25 min Q&A/close):
1) Quick intros + session objectives (5m)
2) Controls mapping & model/data boundaries (20m)
3) Evidence locations / log retention / key artifacts (20m)
4) Open Q&A / next steps (25m)

Can you confirm who from FinPay will join and whether your pen-test vendor can be on the call for the controls mapping portion? If none of those windows work we can propose evening availability but would prefer to avoid >120 minute blocks.

Karthik
